items.html: And those who look into the internality of this wisdom, which is the secret of the Daat, illuminate and sparkle in its likeness. And this Daat is called the upper firmament, in the secret of Bina, which is called the firmament, as is known. And there is no Daat without Bina, and no Bina without Daat. And from the aspect of its being a firmament separating between Arich Anpin and ZA, there is in it radiance and sparkle, as I explained.
